title: Unify MCP configuration and separate from conversation history
body:
Environment

  - Platform (select one):
    - Anthropic API
  - Claude CLI version: 1.0.33 (Claude Code)
  - Operating System: macOS 15.5 (Darwin 24.5.0)
  - Terminal: Apple Terminal

  Bug Description

  1. The .claude.json file gets filled up with conversation history mixed with MCP
  configurations, causing issues
  2. MCP configuration format differs between Claude CLI and Claude Desktop app, requiring
  separate config files instead of a unified approach

  Steps to Reproduce

  1. Configure MCP servers in .claude.json for Claude CLI
  2. Use Claude CLI for conversations - history gets added to same file
  3. Try to use same MCP config with Claude Desktop app
  4. Observe that different config format/location is required

  Expected Behavior

  - MCP configuration should be separate from conversation history
  - Single unified mcp.json config file should work for both Claude CLI and Claude Desktop app

  Actual Behavior

  - Conversation history and MCP config mixed in same .claude.json file causes issues
  - Claude CLI and Desktop app require different MCP configuration formats/locations

  Additional Context

  This creates a poor developer experience requiring users to maintain separate MCP
  configurations for CLI vs Desktop, and the mixing of history with config in CLI makes config
  management problematic.
author: expozeur

top_comments.author: ollie-anthropic
top_comments.body: Hey all, sorry for the delayed reply on this. I understand this is unideal, and I hope to improve the situation on this shortly. Will keep you posted

top_comments.author: tarikbo-aws
top_comments.body: +1 for this one, this is terrible design. Even claude-code could not figure out where my config made using mcp add -s (for user) was actually stored. Very hard to version, edit, backup, etc. my configuration.
